budget: To start budgeting with MyFinergy, track your monthly income and expenses using the 50/30/20 rule.
investment: MyFinergy suggests starting with low-risk index funds, mutual funds, or systematic investment plans (SIPs).
loan: You can calculate your estimated home or personal loan EMIs using our interest rate calculator.
savings: Aim to keep 3 to 6 months of living expenses in an emergency savings account.
credit card: Pay your total credit card balance in full every month to avoid high interest charges and build your credit score.
tax: MyFinergy helps you maximize tax savings under Section 80C through ELSS mutual funds and PPF.
